periods.name: 九宝金刚杵
periods.description: Carbuncle's 'treasure hammer' formed from emerald, topaz, opal, aquamarine, garnet, ruby, sapphire, diamond and other jewels around an iron staff. Kinji destroys its gem head with Zetsukugi.
